verdict.rationale: RudderStack ships AI features (Rudder AI Slack agent, MCP server), so a buyer could fairly ask whether customer data is used to train AI models. The pack contains no AI-training opt-out, no model-training data policy, and no contractual no-training commitment. The data-residency, self-hosting and PII-masking items concern general data handling, not training use, so they cannot be credited here.
